description: This file defines the CustomerOptionService interface, which provides methods for managing CustomerOption entities, including listing options by store and language, saving or updating options, and retrieving options by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionService
classes.description: A Java interface for managing customer option entities related to customer attributes, offering methods for listing, saving, updating, and retrieving customer options.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieve a list of CustomerOption objects for a given store and language, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new or update an existing CustomerOption entity, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a CustomerOption by store and option code.
